fields.aboutUs:
Brookfield Kindergarten is situated in Lees Park on the corner of Bellevue and Otumoetai Roads.

We are committed to providing quality education opportunities in a fun, loving, challenging and innovative environment.

We aspire to be a welcoming and inclusive kindergarten where relationships are respectful and responsive, the teachers and the children are inspired where we create reflective and motivated learners for life.

Our kindergarten holds a Gold standard in the Healthy Heart Award and currently holds the Silver Enviroschools award.

We honour Te Tiriti O Waitangi and respect the environment through sustainable practices.

Visitors are always welcome.

fields.aboutUs:
Situated in the central Mount area, adjacent to Omanu Primary School our kindergarten has been part of the Mount Maunganui education sector and community for over 45 years.

We believe that having strong collaborative relationships with children and family is fundamental to learning/whanaungatanga. We provide a welcoming atmosphere that is positive, respectful, inclusive, emotionally nurturing and fun.

We believe children learn best through direct experiences that are initiated by the child within their play, incorporating challenges and cooperative ventures; and that children learn at their own pace in a holistic way. We provide a rich and stimulating environment that provides for open ended exploration.

We value teaching children about the environment and aim to foster a generation of people who instinctively think and act sustainably.

Quick reminders, please bring a:
- Spare change of clothes
- Named water bottle
- Healthy snack
- Sun hats (Term 1 & 4) 

Please encourage your child to bring in, and hang up, their own bag, so they know where it is when they need it.

fields.aboutUs:
At Kāramuramu Kindergarten we aspire to create an environment that empowers this community of learners to realise their full potential.

Named after the Kāramuramu, a hardy native shrub that produces lots of fruit, it is used in the regeneration of native bush. It symbolises the community spirit that gave new life to a local organisation that is vital to the lives of our tamariki.

We have a fantastic and fun teaching team that are 100% qualified.

Our beautiful outdoor space that provides an exciting environment for children to pursue their interests and actively explore.

Our vision is to provide a warm and welcoming environment that assists children to become imaginative, creative and connected lifelong learners.

Situated in the heart of Greerton Village beside the local primary school, our kindergarten boasts a large natural outdoor environment where learning in and about nature is central to our daily programme.

Our kindergarten philosophy focuses on celebrating biculturalism, authentic relationships, uniqueness of each child, education for sustainability and encouraging creativity.

Our teaching team are passionate teachers and learners who share a commitment to providing high quality education for each child. We value building strong relationships through making positive connections with children, whānau/family and the community.

At our kindergarten, children experience an environment where their health is promoted and their emotional, physical and spiritual well-being is nurtured. Children's creativity is fostered by allowing children to form original ideas through exploration, imagination and discovery.

Cherished by Matua's children for about three decades now, you'll find us at the end of Audrey Place, located next to Matua Primary School.

Come and meet the friendly, qualified team at Matua Kindergarten and discover more about our philosophy and approach, and why we love teaching!

Our purpose is to; Grow confident, competent life-long learners through their play. Together, we cultivate a place where your child can feel happy, safe and at ease.

Our approach encourages exploration and free play, stimulating curiosity, discovery and self-directed learning development. During the day, our programme full of diverse resources, activities and (adventures!) provides children with a rich variety of learning opportunities - and tons of fun!

Just as a woven cord is stronger, we believe in partnering with our families and the wider community of Matua, and in honouring the heart beat of Te Tiriti o Waitangi.

So come for a visit! We'd love to pop the kettle on and invite you into our space. A wonderful space - here at Matua kindergarten.

It is a privilege to learn alongside you and your tamaiti at Maungaarangi, ‘Mountains in the Sky’.

Our kindergarten is located on the grounds of Welcome Bay School. We have a beautiful, large outdoor environment where tamariki play in all weather, take risks and learn about caring for Papatūānuku.

Our vision is ‘Awakening Wairua and Growing Leaders.’ We achieve this by growing respectful, nurturing relationships, caring for ourselves and others.

The partnerships we form with whānau and tamariki are supported by the pou of our localised curriculum – Manaakitanga, Wairuatanga, Whanaungatanga, Mātauranga and Kaitiakitanga, where together we grow future rangatira/leaders.

We'd love to meet you and your whānau. So come for a visit and we'll pop the kettle on!

Maunganui All Day Kindergarten (formerly Mount Plunket Preschool) was established in 1988 with a clear aim to provide quality care and education for the children in our community.

We are proud of our small mixed aged kindergarten and the warm, welcoming family focused environment.

You and your child will experience a learning programme that is based on a child-centred, free play philosophy. Your child’s needs are planned for based on their interests, strengths and passions.

We value diversity and embrace all children into our kindergarten, aware and supportive of their cultural understandings, differences and similarities.

Our teaching team are dedicated, highly qualified and enthusiastic educators who share a sense of connection with our community, families and children.

We aim to gift children with a sense of identity and confidence while having fun and building self-esteem.

Our kindergarten is a special place where children have room to run, discover, create and imagine! It's a place where childhood is celebrated and unhurried.

So come and discover Otamarakau Kindergarten, where your child will be encouraged, inspired, and nurtured while discovering, experiencing and learning about the world around them.

We welcome all families and whānau to come and visit us! Come and enjoy a cuppa in our stunning natural environment and meet our awesome team of highly-qualified, friendly teachers.

Situated in the coastal suburb of Papamoa we pride ourselves on providing high quality education with a focus on sustainability.

Our sustainable focus flows through all aspects of our teaching and learning programme and is reflected in our beautiful natural environment.

We have been a part of the Enviro-Schools programme since 2004 and proudly hold a Green Gold award. The programme encourages children to instinctively think and act in sustainable ways and to foster environmental sustainability amongst the local community.

A key focus of our philosophy is to foster a sense of belonging for both children and their families/whānau. Our teachers work closely with parents/whānau to promote and celebrate children's achievements.

We have a strong emphasis on empowering children as learners which assists with their transition to school.

fields.aboutUs:
Located next door to Te Akau ki Primary School, Papamoa Kindergarten boasts a stunning outdoor environment where tamariki/children can thrive and connect with nature.

We are extremely passionate about Education for Sustainability (EfS) and a strong focus of our programme is developing children’s knowledge and understanding about caring for the environment. We were one of the first kindergartens in New Zealand to achieve the prestigious Green-Gold EnviroSchools status and we were also a 2017 and 2018 Finalist for Prime Minister Awards in Education Excellence.

Our kindergarten philosophy developed in consultation with our whānau is based upon six pou/foundational posts; Whanaungatanga/relationships, ako/teaching & learning, wairuatanga/ spirituality, manakitanga/kindness and generosity, rangatiratanga/ leadership, and social justice are the posts we believe reflect the very essence of our place.

Mālo ni, Fakaalofa lahi atu, Kia orāna, Tālofa lava, Mālō e lelei, Talofa, Noa'ia, Ni sa bula vinaka, Halo olgeta, Mauri, Tēnā koutou katoa, and warm greetings to you all.

Tai o Fenua Kindergarten is a place where everyone is welcome, and where Pacific languages, culture and identity are nurtured and celebrated. Our kindergarten philosophy is grounded upon the values of family, love, and working together.

Teachers are guided by family spiritual values and beliefs, and make the most of teachable moments to encourage dispositions of gratitude and kindness. Here with us your child’s ancestral connections are honoured.

We believe children learn best through play, actively exploring their environment in a ‘hands-on’ journey of discovery. The environment is set up in way that provokes and promotes the curiosity, awe and wonder of children.

We work closely alongside the Pacific Island Trust Bay Of Plenty in order to serve the needs of our community as best we can. Come for a kindergarten visit today! Come and meet our warm, friendly, and experienced teachers.

Nau mai, Haere Mai ki Te Puke Kindergarten.

Te Puke Kindergarten is a place for play, where children can be children and learn through their unique ways of being.

Te Puke Kindergarten feels like home, our community is welcome, our whānau are whānau forever and our tamariki are treasured for who they are and what they bring with them.

We treasure tamariki, whanaungatanga – we are all in this together, aroha – letting a loving heart guide our decisions, manākitanga – caring for the land and the people, and rangatira – nurturing children to be the best version of themselves.

He taonga te mokopuna kia whāngai, kia tupu, kia reo A child is a treasure, to nurture to grow, to flourish.

Thames Coast Kindergarten is a small, locally connected early childhood centre in Te Puru, just north of Thames on the Coromandel Peninsula. For more than 30 years, it has served coastal families as a place where tamariki learn, play, and grow together, while parents and whānau build lasting community connections.

Our coastal setting plays an important role in our learning programme. With the beach, creek and local domain nearby, children regularly explore the natural environment, developing curiosity about the world around them and building a sense of kaitiakitanga - caring for and respecting the environment.

Families remain at our heart. Parents, grandparents and caregivers are welcome to visit us!

We believe play is integral for learning and development and our unique environment supports and celebrates this. Our programme is hugely influenced by nature based education.

Visits to ngahere (the bush) are a regular occurrence and provide rich and open ended learning experiences for our children. We value children learning about nature in nature, and letting nature be the teacher.

We believe that children must be given every opportunity and above all the time to connect with nature in its wildest form.

We promote healthy and sustainable practices where children are involved in activities including composting, conservation, recycling and gardening.

OPEYS All Day Kindergarten (formerly known as OPEYS Plunket Education and Care Centre) have been proudly serving our families and the Tauranga community for over 40 years.

We are an All Day Kindergarten dedicated to providing quality education and care for children from birth right up to school age.

We understand that each child is unique and has their own independent needs and interests. Our learning programme is child-centred allowing children to get involved, explore and investigate.

We value diversity and embrace all children into our kindergarten, aware and supportive of their cultural understandings, differences and similarities.

Our passionate teaching team promotes the art of play, understanding that children learn and develop best when they are free to pursue their own curiosity.

Together with our parents and whānau we want to engage our children in learning experiences that build happy, confident people with a love of learning.
